+=== camel-mongodb - SslAwareMongoClient percent-encodes the username and password
+`org.apache.camel.component.mongodb.SslAwareMongoClient` (the client the MongoDB Kamelets create) put the username and
+password into its connection string without percent-encoding them. A password with `@`, `:`, `/`, `?` or `%` failed to
+connect, and an encoded sequence such as `%41` was decoded, so the client logged in with another password. The client
+now encodes both itself: give the username and password as they are. A password that was percent-encoded by hand to
+work around this (for example `p%40ss` for `p@ss`) must now be given unencoded.
